sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Beacon Chain State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the core slot-by-slot and epoch-by-epoch state transition logic of the beacon chain, including slot processing, epoch processing, and block application.

nodes.label: Slot Start
nodes.description: Beginning of a new slot; previous state root cached, block header state root updated, previous block root cached.

nodes.label: Process Slot
nodes.description: Cache current state root, update latest block header state root, cache previous block root into block_roots.

nodes.label: Slot Processed (No Block)
nodes.description: Slot processing complete; if no block present, this is a skipped slot.

nodes.label: Process Block
nodes.description: Apply block to state: validate header, process RANDAO, ETH1 data, and all operations (slashings, attestations, deposits, exits).

nodes.label: Block Applied to State
nodes.description: Block fully processed; state updated with all operations. State root must match block's declared state_root.

nodes.label: Verify State Root
nodes.description: Compare computed state root against block.state_root; reject block if mismatch.

nodes.label: Epoch Boundary Reached
nodes.description: Last slot of an epoch completed; epoch processing must execute.

nodes.label: Process Epoch
nodes.description: Execute justification/finalization, rewards/penalties, registry updates, slashings, effective balance updates, RANDAO/historical resets.

nodes.label: Epoch Processed
nodes.description: All epoch processing complete; justification bits updated, balances adjusted, validator registry updated.

nodes.label: State Transition Invalid
nodes.description: State transition failed due to assertion failure, overflow, invalid signature, or state root mismatch.

edges.label: Check computed state root against block

external_entities.name: Block Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator selected to propose a signed beacon block for the current slot.

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Validator Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the full lifecycle of a validator from deposit to withdrawal, including activation, exit, slashing, and balance management.

nodes.label: Deposit Received
nodes.description: ETH1 deposit processed on beacon chain; validator record created or balance topped up.

nodes.label: Validate Deposit
nodes.description: Verify Merkle proof against eth1_data.deposit_root, check BLS signature over DepositMessage.

nodes.label: Pending Activation
nodes.description: Validator has 32 ETH effective balance; activation_eligibility_epoch set, waiting in activation queue.

nodes.label: Process Activation Queue
nodes.description: During epoch processing, activate validators respecting churn limit (max 4 + active_count/65536 per epoch).

nodes.label: Validator Active
nodes.description: Validator is active: eligible to propose blocks, attest, and earn rewards.

nodes.label: Initiate Validator Exit
nodes.description: Set exit_epoch respecting churn limit; triggered by voluntary exit or forced ejection (balance < 16 ETH).

nodes.label: Validator Exiting
nodes.description: Validator has exit_epoch set; still active until exit_epoch reached.

nodes.label: Validator Exited
nodes.description: Validator no longer active; waiting for withdrawable_epoch (exit_epoch + 256 epochs).

nodes.label: Validator Withdrawable
nodes.description: Validator can withdraw remaining balance.

nodes.label: Slash Validator
nodes.description: Mark validator as slashed, reduce balance by 1/128, force exit with extended withdrawal delay.

nodes.label: Validator Slashed
nodes.description: Validator marked as slashed; forced exit initiated, extended withdrawable_epoch.

external_entities.name: ETH1 Deposit Contract
external_entities.description: Ethereum 1.0 deposit contract that holds validator deposits and generates Merkle roots.

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Block Operation Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models all validation checks performed during block processing: proposer slashings, attester slashings, attestation validation, deposit validation, and voluntary exit validation.

nodes.label: Block Operations Received
nodes.description: Block body contains operations to validate: up to 16 proposer slashings, 2 attester slashings, 128 attestations, 16 deposits, 16 voluntary exits.

nodes.label: Validate Proposer Slashing
nodes.description: Verify two conflicting signed block headers from same proposer: different headers for same slot, valid BLS signatures, proposer not already slashed.

nodes.label: Validate Attester Slashing
nodes.description: Verify two conflicting indexed attestations (surround or double vote), valid signatures, at least one common slashable validator.

nodes.label: Validate Attestation
nodes.description: Check: slot within epoch range, valid committee index, aggregation bits length matches committee, inclusion delay 1-32 slots, source matches justified checkpoint, valid aggregate BLS signature.

nodes.label: Validate Deposit Proof
nodes.description: Verify Merkle proof of deposit against eth1_data.deposit_root; verify BLS signature over DepositMessage.

nodes.label: Validate Voluntary Exit
nodes.description: Check: validator is active, not already exited, epoch >= current epoch, BLS signature valid over VoluntaryExit message.

nodes.label: Validate Block Header
nodes.description: Verify: slot > parent slot, correct parent root, correct proposer index, valid block signature.

nodes.label: Validate RANDAO Reveal
nodes.description: Verify BLS signature of current epoch by proposer matches RANDAO reveal in block.

nodes.label: All Validations Passed
nodes.description: All block operations validated successfully; state transitions applied.

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: Any validation check failed; block rejected, state transition aborted.

edges.label: First: validate block header and signature

external_entities.name: Block Producer
external_entities.description: Entity that constructed the beacon block with all operations.

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Justification and Finalization
sub_graphs.description: Models the Casper FFG justification and finalization mechanism, including supermajority attestation tallying, justification bit management, and finalization conditions.

nodes.label: Epoch Attestations Tallied
nodes.description: All matching attestations for source, target, and head computed; balances summed for previous and current epochs.

nodes.label: Update Justification Bits
nodes.description: Shift justification_bits left, set bit if previous/current epoch target attestation balance >= 2/3 of total active balance.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Justified
nodes.description: An epoch checkpoint reached supermajority (2/3) attestation; justification bit set.

nodes.label: Check Finalization Conditions
nodes.description: Check 4 finalization rules: (1) epochs N-3..N-1 justified via N-3, (2) N-2..N-1 via N-2, (3) N-2..N via N-2, (4) N-1..N via N-1.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Finalized
nodes.description: A justified checkpoint is finalized; all state before this checkpoint is irreversible.

nodes.label: Finality Delay Active
nodes.description: Finality delay exceeds 4 epochs; inactivity leak activated to force finalization.

nodes.label: Apply Inactivity Leak
nodes.description: Non-participating validators suffer exponential balance drain; participating validators' penalties cancelled.

edges.label: Check if justified checkpoint can be finalized

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Reward and Penalty Economics
sub_graphs.description: Models the reward and penalty calculations for validators including base rewards, attestation rewards for source/target/head, proposer rewards, and slashing penalties.

nodes.label: Compute Base Reward
nodes.description: Calculate: effective_balance * BASE_REWARD_FACTOR / sqrt(total_balance) / 4.

nodes.label: Compute Attestation Rewards
nodes.description: For each component (source/target/head): reward = base_reward * attesting_balance / total_active_balance for participants; penalty = base_reward for non-participants.

nodes.label: Compute Proposer Reward
nodes.description: Proposer receives base_reward / PROPOSER_REWARD_QUOTIENT for each attestation included.

nodes.label: Compute Slashing Penalty
nodes.description: Slashed validator loses effective_balance / 128 immediately; additional proportional penalty at epoch processing based on total slashed balance in window.

nodes.label: Validator Balances Updated
nodes.description: All rewards and penalties applied to validator balances for the epoch.

nodes.label: Update Effective Balances
nodes.description: Effective balance updated with hysteresis: only changes if actual balance differs by > 1.25 ETH from effective balance. Capped at 32 ETH.

edges.label: Use base reward for attestation calculations

ambiguities.text: The 'churn limit' formula (max 4 + active_count/65536) applies to both activations and exits but the interaction between simultaneous high activation and exit churn is not explicit.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume activation churn and exit churn are independent limits, each allowing up to (4 + active/65536) per epoch. This needs verification against implementation.

ambiguities.text: ETH1 data voting requires '50% agreement during voting period' but the exact tie-breaking rule when multiple candidates have equal votes is not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume tie-breaking favors the latest ETH1 block by timestamp among candidates with equal vote counts.

ambiguities.text: The spec does not explicitly state what happens when a deposit has a valid Merkle proof but an invalid BLS signature.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the validator record is created but with an invalid pubkey; the validator can never activate since they cannot produce valid attestation signatures.

implicit_assumptions.description: BLS signature scheme is secure and unforgeable under the computational Diffie-Hellman assumption.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could forge block proposals, attestations, RANDAO reveals, slashing proofs, and voluntary exits, completely breaking consensus.

implicit_assumptions.description: At least 2/3 of active validators are honest and online for finalization to progress.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Finality stalls, inactivity leak activates draining inactive validators, but chain cannot finalize until honest supermajority returns.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control enough validators to produce conflicting justified checkpoints on different forks simultaneously.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Could create a finality split where two incompatible chains both finalize, breaking the single-chain assumption.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RANDAO mixing process with proposer reveals produces sufficiently unpredictable randomness for committee shuffling.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could predict future committee assignments and concentrate stake to control specific slots or committees.
